1|## Chapter 40 — The First Martian Winter Offensive
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents waited for Earth's mercy. You take the initiative to shape your own fate."*  
     4|*General Tomas Hale VII: "We're not just breaking the blockade. We're proving that Martian ingenuity cannot be contained."*
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a readiness pulse: Task Force Ares - All Systems Green for Winter Offensive Launch. General Tomas Hale VII adjusted his spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent knowing how armies actually move when politics and physics align, as he looked at the notification flashing across his console in the Valles Marineris Defense Authority's operational planning chamber.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," he said, his voice carrying the rasp of years spent in command bunkers and the quiet focus of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of this operation."
